narr: Rain showers began to develop and increase in coverage late on March 11, 2023. While these showers were non-severe and heavy rainfall was only local in nature, training of these showers in Lawrence County resulted in brief flooding of low water crossings.
ev: Training thunderstorms flooded a low water crossing along Gwinn Road south of Ethridge. No damages are known.
lsr: A FEW INCHES OF WATER FLOWING OVER GWINN ROAD SOUTH OF ETHRIDGE AT LOW WATER CROSSING.
